isolatedProtocol.ingress: Real NextRequest/NextResponse objects in an ephemeral Node HTTP server; not actual Next App Router
isolatedProtocol.policyEnforcement: Real NestJS Fastify controller created exclusively in test process
isolatedProtocol.serverTrustedProof: In-memory opaque session handle issued by test BFF, resolved by Nest fixture map; never user headers
isolatedProtocol.decisionEngine: Accepted W1 Python PEP/PDP bridge invoked inline BEFORE fake source.read()
isolatedProtocol.source: In-memory synthetic counter with two owners in one synthetic tenant; no DB connectors
isolatedProtocol.audit: Allowlisted in-memory requestId/operation/decision/reasonCode, pre-source; not persistent or operational audit

limitations: Testing only: the Nest lab controller is not part of real API AppModule or routed in production
The test NextRequest objects run within an ephemeral Node HTTP test server, not an actual built Next app route
Source touch refers only to fake in-memory source counters, not PostgreSQL physical reads
Two fake owners with identical synthetic tenant do not prove legally approved same-tenant ownership separation
Positive SIMULATED_ALLOW is not an operational permission
No database, Docker, prod deployment, real source, real account or share transactions used
An in-memory audit failure is fail-closed but no durable audit chain is supplied
No claim of complete CI/release acceptance until actual GitHub workflow execution
